fields.label: Default Print Format
fields.description: Used to render the PDF snapshot for this document type.

fields.label: Allow External Signers
fields.description: If unchecked, only User can be added as a signer for this document type's requests.

fields.label: Require Signature to Submit
fields.description: Block submitting a document until its latest signature request is signed by everyone.

fields.label: Submit When Signed
fields.description: Submit the document automatically once everyone has signed its latest request. If submitting fails, it stays in draft with a comment saying why.

fields.options:
To have Request Signature open with the signers already listed, define get_signers() on this doctype's controller. It returns a list of dicts, one per signer, in signing order:

def get_signers(self):
    return [
        {"signer_type": "Employee", "signer_reference": self.employee},
        {"signer_type": "User", "signer_reference": self.approver},
        {"signer_type": "Email", "signer_name": "Jane Doe", "signer_email": "jane@example.com"},
    ]
  • signer_type (required): User, Employee, Customer, Supplier or Email. Anything but User needs Allow External Signers.
  • signer_reference (required, except Email): the record's name. Name and email are always taken from that record.
  • signer_email (Email only, required) and signer_name (Email only, optional).

Every entry becomes a signer. Unusable entries (no email on the record, unknown type, duplicate email) are shown to the requester as warnings; the rest still load.
